concerns.text: Task T040 ‘Code cleanup and refactoring of error‑handling paths’ is too coarse – it lacks a concrete deliverable (e.g., specific files or functions to modify) and does not specify how completion will be verified.
Task T041 ‘Optimize API request batching where rate limits permit’ is vague; it does not define a measurable artifact (e.g., a revised batching module) nor a verification method.

Task T032b ‘Implement src/utils/measure_runtime.py to log total pipeline execution time against the 6‑hour budget’ does not state how the implementation will be validated (e.g., a test asserting the log file exists and contains a numeric runtime).
Task T033 ‘Implement src/evaluation/classify_failures.py …’ lacks an explicit verification step (such as a contract test or a sample output file) to confirm the script produces the required CSV.
Task T034 ‘Generate data/evaluation/failure_topology_report.csv …’ does not specify how to verify the CSV’s creation or its contents (e.g., a test that checks file existence and schema compliance).
Task T035 ‘Merge failure‑topology metrics into statistical_summary.csv where appropriate’ provides no verification mechanism (e.g., a diff check or test) to ensure the merge was performed correctly.

Task T036 ‘Implement src/evaluation/analyze_failure_topology.py to produce a qualitative markdown report …’ lacks a defined acceptance criterion (e.g., existence of the markdown file and a sanity‑check test).

Task T037 ‘Implement src/utils/changelog.py to append pipeline changes to data/evaluation/changelog.md …’ does not describe how to confirm that changelog entries are correctly appended (e.g., a unit test).

Task T038 ‘Implement src/evaluation/sensitivity_analysis.py … and append results to data/evaluation/sensitivity_report.csv’ lacks a verification step (such as a test that the CSV is created and matches the expected schema).
